about: Floors for the CI throughput smoke (benchmarks/throughput_smoke.py, ci.yml job throughput-smoke).
Each entry runs benchmarks/db_throughput.py at the smoke size (200k rows) and fails the job
below min_rows_per_second. rows/s is over the whole engine call, Gate-8 included; at 200k the
in-memory verification ladder runs too, so it is lower than a 1M run on the same route.
Floors are set against a machine whose calibrate() takes reference_calibration_seconds (the
local 4-vCPU box, 2026-11-21: 0.39 s). On a slower runner the smoke scales each floor down by
reference / measured (never up): two hosted-runner jobs on the same commit ran 2x apart
(runs 44923502709 and 44936017037). Local clean rates, 100k rows, after -> floor:
pg-pg copy 1768 -> 1000, pg-pg row path 524 -> 300, pg-mysql (MariaDB) 446 -> 300,
mysql-pg 550 -> 330. The code before the fast paths ran 236-271 rows/s on the row path there,
so losing them trips the gate. Raise a floor only with the CI artifacts that justify it.
